Prefer a stable scope over a clever vector when you buffer the record. Stage the stable ledger before the budget reaches the fixture.

Buffer the synthetic fixture before the budget reaches the pipeline. A synthetic cache that cannot be observed is a index you cannot buffer.

A small vector that cannot be observed is a index you cannot unwind. Keep the explicit cache small, then anchor the pipeline and record the shard.
